text_markup: An ability cannot see the set-aside zone unless it specifically sets objects aside or refers to set-aside objects. Outside of these cases, cards moved into another zone from the set-aside zone are treated as though they entered that zone directly from their location prior to being set aside.
text_plain: An ability cannot see the set-aside zone unless it specifically sets objects aside or refers to set-aside objects. Outside of these cases, cards moved into another zone from the set-aside zone are treated as though they entered that zone directly from their location prior to being set aside.

examples.text_markup: The Runner is playing as {card:Exile} and plays Test Run, searching their heap for a program. Although the program is set aside before being installed, {card:Exile}'s ability treats it as though it were installed directly from the heap, and so {card:Exile} will draw a card.
examples.text_plain: The Runner is playing as Exile and plays Test Run, searching their heap for a program. Although the program is set aside before being installed, Exile's ability treats it as though it were installed directly from the heap, and so Exile will draw a card.
